local p = {}



function p.get(frame)
	local args = (frame.args[1] and frame.args) or frame:getParent().args
	
    local keysString = ""
    if args["Upgrade_No"] ~= nil then
        keysString = keysString .."X4bUpgrade_NoX4r".. args["Upgrade_No"]
    end

    for key, _ in pairs(args) do
        if key ~= "Upgrade_No" then
            keysString = keysString .."X4b".. key .. "X4r".. _
        end
    end

	return keysString
end

return p
